Employees Old Age Benefit Act 1976

EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE BENEFIT ACT, 1976
EMPLOYEES' OLD-AGE BENEFIT ACT, 1976
(Rate of payment to insured persons and their survivors)
Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 14th September, 2010]
S.R.O. 86(KE)/2010,
dated 26-7-2010.---Under the power vested in it by clause (a) of section 2 of
the Employees' Old-age Benefit Act, 1976 the Federal Government is pleased to
allow following payments to the insured persons and their survivors with effect
from 1-7-2010:
S.No.
Nature of payment
Rate
Beneficiary
1.
Additional Pension to
the pensioners getting pension less than Rs.3,000 per month.
Amount equal to the
deficiency from Rs.3,000 or 15% of existing pension whichever is higher.
Provided that the reduced pension shall remain reduced as per subsection (2E)
of section 22.
Insured Persons and
survivors.
2.
Additional Pension to
the female child of a deceased insured person already in receipt of pension
after attaining the age of 18 years, till marriage.
Equal to the pension
allowed to such female child.
Female child of
insured person.
3.
Additional Pension to
disabled child of deceased insured persons already in receipt of pension
after attaining the age of 18 years till death.
Equal to. the pension
allowed to such child.
Disabled child of
deceased insured person.
4.
Additional pension to
pensioners.
At the rate of 15% of
existing pensions.
All pensioners having
pension at the rate of more than Rs.3,000 per month.
